items.question: What is ZTLGuard?
items.answer: An Italy ZTL (limited-traffic zone) alert app for iOS and Android. Package: com.zuki.apps.ztlguard.

items.question: Does it upload my location?
items.answer: No. Position is used only on-device to measure distance to zone boundaries. It is not stored or uploaded.

items.question: Do I need GPS?
items.answer: No. You can browse cities and zones without GPS. Location is optional for distance alerts.

items.question: Is the zone data official live municipal data?
items.answer: ZTLGuard does not represent a government entity. It is not affiliated with the Italian government or any municipality. Published polygons are adapted from municipal open data: Florence, Bologna, Bergamo, Pavia, Genova, Lecce, Trento, and Turin (CC BY 4.0) and Naples (IODL 2.0). Hours are not inferred from the polygons. Milan, Rome, Verona, Venice, and Pisa are labelled Demonstration and are not municipal truth. Sources: https://opendata.comune.fi.it/ · https://opendata.comune.bologna.it/explore/dataset/zona-a-traffico-limitato/ · https://www.dati.lombardia.it/Trasporti/Comune-Bergamo-Zone-a-Traffico-Limitato-ZTL-/tkwz-spd9 · https://www.dati.lombardia.it/Trasporti/MappaZTL_Pavia_WGS84/axvu-yx4b · https://dati.comune.genova.it/dataset/zone-a-traffico-limitato · https://dati.comune.lecce.it/dataset/ztl-apu-centro-storico-lecce · https://www.comune.trento.it/ · https://trasparenza.comune.napoli.it/flex/cm/pages/ServeBLOB.php/L/IT/IDPagina/46176 · https://aperto.comune.torino.it/dataset/zone-traffico-limitato

items.question: Does this stop me from getting a fine?
items.answer: No. ZTLGuard is an informational navigation aid. It does not grant permission or confirm a fine. Local signs and the comune always win.

items.question: What is free vs Premium?
items.answer: Free includes the map, Rome and Florence, foreground alerts up to 500 m, and ads on non-driving screens. Premium is an optional monthly subscription (ztlguard_premium): all cities, voice alerts, offline data, 1–2 km lead, keep-awake Driving Mode, background alerts where the phone allows, and no ads. The warning itself is not paywalled. The store shows the price.

items.question: Why isn't my city available?
items.answer: Zone data depends on official municipal open-data feeds. Some cities are missing licensed GeoJSON. Demo data is labelled in-app.

items.question: Can I report a wrong zone while driving?
items.answer: No. Driving Mode blocks reports to prevent distraction. Submit a zone report after you stop.

items.question: How do I restore Premium?
items.answer: Premium is a monthly subscription (ztlguard_premium). Use Restore purchases on the Premium screen. Cancel in your App Store or Google Play subscription settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for ZTLGuard — Italy ZTL Alerts.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use ZTLGuard and related pages at zukiapps.com/ztl-guard.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the ZTLGuard app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: ZTLGuard is designed to work on-device. Location is used only to measure distance to zone boundaries.
items: On-device location while the app is open (optional, after permission) — not stored or uploaded
City and zone data cached on device
Premium status stored on device
Feedback and support messages you send
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Show nearby ZTL zones and distances on your device
Operate and improve ZTLGuard
Respond to support requests
Validate in-app purchases
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and tracking
section4.content: Users who do not have Premium see ads. Ads are not shown in Driving Mode. Location is not used for ads.
section4.content2: Location permission can be denied; you can still browse cities and zones.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Zone cache and settings remain on device until you uninstall. Location is not retained after you leave the session.
section5.content2: Ad and purchase partners retain data under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Apple App Store and Google Play Billing may process purchase data under their policies. Map tiles may be fetched from the map provider while you browse.
section6.content2: We do not sell your personal information. We do not upload your GPS track.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. To delete a ZTLGuard account, follow the steps at zukiapps.com/ztl-guard/delete-account or email zuki.apps.dev@gmail.com.
section7.content2: ZTLGuard is a general-audience travel utility. It is not directed to children under 13. It is not a substitute for official signs or local rules.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

section2.content: ZTLGuard is an informational aid concerning limited-traffic zones (zone a traffico limitato) in selected Italian cities. It includes:
items: A map drawn as an aid. It is not a complete cadastre and it is not an official survey by any municipality.

Zone information may be missing, incomplete, out of date, or incorrect. Milan, Rome, Verona, Venice, and Pisa are shown from demonstration data and are not municipal records. deleteAccount.title: Delete your ZTLGuard account
deleteAccount.metaDescription: Request deletion of your ZTLGuard account and associated data from Zuki Apps. Steps, what is deleted, what is kept, and the retention period.
deleteAccount.intro: ZTLGuard by Zuki Apps lets you sign in with Google or Apple. This page is how you ask Zuki Apps to delete that account and the data tied to it.
deleteAccount.warningBody: After we delete the account, sign-in, reports, and saved settings for that account are gone. Store purchases stay with Apple or Google.
deleteAccount.step1: Send an email to zuki.apps.dev@gmail.com from the Google or Apple address you used in ZTLGuard.
deleteAccount.step2: Use the subject line: Delete ZTLGuard account.
deleteAccount.step3: Say whether you signed in with Google or Apple, and include the email shown on that account.
deleteAccount.step4: We reply to confirm, then delete the ZTLGuard account and the associated data listed below.
deleteAccount.step5: On your phone, uninstall ZTLGuard or use Settings to remove the offline city pack. That data never leaves the device.
deleteAccount.deletedIntro: Within 30 days of a confirmed request we delete:
deleteAccount.deleted1: The ZTLGuard sign-in account (Firebase Auth user id, and the name or email provided by Google or Apple).
deleteAccount.deleted2: Profile and settings stored with that account.
deleteAccount.deleted3: Zone reports you submitted while signed in.
deleteAccount.kept1: Location. ZTLGuard does not upload your GPS position or trip history, so there is no location record to delete.
deleteAccount.kept2: Purchase records held by Apple or Google for ztlguard_premium. Refunds and restore follow the store, not this request.
deleteAccount.kept3: Crash logs and analytics events that are not linked to your account.
deleteAccount.kept4: Zone data and municipal sources. Those are not your personal data.
deleteAccount.retentionBody: Account data is deleted from our active systems within 30 days of confirmation. Copies in backups are removed on the next backup cycle, and no later than 30 days after the account is deleted. We do not keep the account for longer than that unless the law requires a specific record.
deleteAccount.guestBody: A guest session is not an account. Uninstalling ZTLGuard removes the on-device cache. There is no Zuki Apps account to delete.
